articles.lede: Southeast College was the host of a Nuclear Supply Chain Workshop, with business owners and locals invited to register for the two-day workshop. During the event, a speaker from the Saskatchewan Industrial and Mining Suppliers Association (SIMSA) spoke to the gathered attendees about the upcoming SMR in Estevan. The workshop as a whole was put on by Southeast TechHub, with Executive Director Gordon More saying he learned a lot from their guest, Nuclear Specialist Grant Cherkas.
